Smart Data Models' laneDirection needs a road segment to mean anything, which the counters do not name. Absent when the counter sums both directions.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

vehicleType.description: The one kind of vehicle the observation counts, in the Smart Data Model's words; absent when the counter sums every class of motor vehicle.

TrafficFlowObserved.title: TrafficFlowObserved

Vehicle.description: One HSL bus, tram, metro, train or ferry in service, where it is, how fast it moves and how late it runs.

delay.description: Seconds behind the timetable, negative when ahead (HSL's dl with the sign turned).

fleetVehicleId.description: The operator and vehicle number HSL publishes, operator-vehicle.

heading.description: Compass heading of the vehicle, degrees clockwise from north.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

nextStop.description: The stop the vehicle stands at or comes to next, the URN of a GtfsStop of this space; HSL moves it on at each departure from or passing of a stop.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

occupancy.description: How full the vehicle is, in percent; HSL sends 0 (room) or 100 (full).

onRoute.description: The line the vehicle is running, the URN of a GtfsRoute of this space.

route.description: The HSL route id the vehicle is serving, as GTFS names it (2550, 1009, 31M1, 3001K).

transportMode.description: What serves the stop or runs the line.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

vehicleType.description: The Smart Data Models kind of vehicle - bus, tram, passengerVessel for a ferry, other for metro and train; transportMode names HSL's mode.

Vehicle.title: Vehicle

WaterQualityObserved.description: One of Forum Virium Helsinki's beach sensors and the water temperature it last read. A sensor that has not reported this season carries no reading.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, as an application credits it beside the licence (CC BY 4.0 for every feed of this space).

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

refPointOfInterest.description: The place in the city's service register the sensor stands at.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

temperature.description: The temperature the station measures: the air at a road weather station, the water at a beach sensor.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

WaterQualityObserved.title: WaterQualityObserved

WeatherObserved.description: One Fintraffic road weather station around Helsinki and its latest readings.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

precipitation.description: Precipitation intensity at the station, millimetres per hour.

relativeHumidity.description: Relative humidity of the air, 0 to 1.

roadSurfaceTemperature.description: Temperature of the road surface at the station.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

temperature.description: The temperature the station measures: the air at a road weather station, the water at a beach sensor.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

windDirection.description: Where the wind comes from, degrees clockwise from north.

windSpeed.description: Mean wind speed at the station.

WeatherObserved.title: WeatherObserved

ServiceRequest.description: One report of the City of Helsinki's feedback system (Open311 GeoReport v2, the Issue Reporting API) that the city published. Smart Data Models names the type service_requests; the space names it ServiceRequest like its other types, with the model's attribute names. The reporter's name, e-mail, phone and photos are never read.

address_string.description: The street or place the reporter named, as written, for example Malminkatu.

agency_responsible.description: The city unit handling the report, when the feedback system names one.

description.description: The report as the reporter wrote it, in the language they wrote it in (`@none`).

expected_datetime.description: When the city expects to have handled the report, if it says.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

requested_datetime.description: When the report was filed, ISO 8601 in UTC.

service_code.description: The feedback system's code of the sector the report is filed under, for example 2809.

service_name.description: The sector's name in English, read from the feedback system's services list, for example City environment.

service_request_id.description: The number the city's feedback system gives the report (Open311 `service_request_id`).

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

status.description: open while the city handles the report (PROCESSING), closed once it has answered (READY).

status_notes.description: The city's answer or note on the report, as published.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

updated_datetime.description: When the report last changed, ISO 8601 in UTC.

ServiceRequest.title: ServiceRequest

ServiceRequestStatus.description: Open311's two report states, as Smart Data Models' service_requests names them.
ServiceRequestStatus.title: ServiceRequestStatus

x-enum-descriptions.closed: The city has answered the report (READY).
x-enum-descriptions.open: The city is handling the report (the feedback system's PROCESSING).
